description:
At Locker Room Labs, our team consists of US-based, senior software engineers passionate about building sports, betting, fantasy, and iGaming technology.

We offer UX Design, MVP Development, Custom App Development, and Staff Augmentation solutions to help bring your software vision to reality.

Our team has created its own sports data platform, “The Playbook”, that reduces client custom software build costs and time to market. This platform has developed and launched almost a dozen direct-to-consumer sports apps.

Sports technology startups and VC-backed founders generally have two decisions when it comes to determining their software development strategy:
- Hire in-house: Increased recruiting costs, lengthy onboarding, expensive total compensation package, often more junior engineers, and employee churn.
- Outsource: Overseas service providers can be more cost-effective at first but generally will require more time managing the project, lack of experience in niche verticals, and sacrificing long-term quality for short-term expense cutting.

If you are looking to bring your sports app vision to life, choose Locker Room Labs to be an extension of your software engineering team and avoid the pitfalls of outsourcing or hiring in-house.
